description: GitHub Copilot OpenTelemetry telemetry in Azure Application Insights, across ALL surfaces (VS Code + Copilot CLI). Copilot spans land in the App Insights 'dependencies' table with cloud_RoleName = the surface and gen_ai.* values in customDimensions; span events land in 'traces' and OTLP metrics in 'customMetrics'. Use the 'Copilot surface' selector and set the Application Insights resource ID on import.

list.name: surface
list.label: Copilot surface
list.query: All (VS Code + CLI) : copilot-chat|github-copilot, VS Code (copilot-chat) : copilot-chat, Copilot CLI (github-copilot) : github-copilot

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize Total=count()

panels.title: Cache Hits (calls)
panels.description: LLM calls with cache-read tokens greater than zero.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend cr=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']) | where cr > 0 | summarize Hits=count()

panels.title: Cache Misses (calls)
panels.description: LLM calls with cache-creation tokens greater than zero.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend cc=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']) | where cc > 0 | summarize Misses=count()

panels.title: Prompt Cache Token Hit Rate
panels.description: Cache-read token volume divided by cache-read plus cache-creation token volume over the selected time range.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), cr=tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), cc=tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize CacheReadTokens=sum(cr), CacheCreationTokens=sum(cc) | extend HitRate=iff(CacheReadTokens + CacheCreationTokens == 0, real(null), 100.0 * CacheReadTokens / (CacheReadTokens + CacheCreationTokens)) | project HitRate
dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) | where op == 'execute_tool' | summarize Tools=count()

panels.title: LLM Calls by Surface
panels.description: chat dependencies split by cloud_RoleName — copilot-chat (VS Code) vs github-copilot (CLI).

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize Calls=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Cache Hit vs Miss Calls Over Time
panels.description: Hits = calls with cache reads. Misses = calls with cache creation.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend cr=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), cc=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']) | summarize Hits=countif(cr > 0), Misses=countif(cc > 0) by bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: AI Credits (AIU)
panels.description: Uses documented `github.copilot.aiu` from `chat` spans when present, otherwise falls back to legacy `github.copilot.nano_aiu` from `invoke_agent` spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query: let Current = dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), Credits=todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.aiu']) | where op == 'chat' and isnotnull(Credits) | summarize Credits=sum(Credits) by operation_Id, cloud_RoleName | where Credits > 0 | extend priority=2; let Legacy = dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), Credits=todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.nano_aiu']) / 1000000000 | where op == 'invoke_agent' and isnotnull(Credits) | summarize Credits=sum(Credits) by operation_Id, cloud_RoleName | where Credits > 0 | extend priority=1; union Current, Legacy | summarize arg_max(priority, Credits) by operation_Id, cloud_RoleName | summarize Credits=sum(Credits)

panels.title: Request Cost
panels.description: Sum of `github.copilot.cost` on `chat` dependencies. GitHub doesn't document the unit, so treat it as a relative indicator.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), cost=todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.cost']) | where op == 'chat' and isnotnull(cost) | summarize Cost=sum(cost)

panels.title: AI Credits by Surface
panels.description: Uses current AIU series when available in a time bucket, otherwise legacy nano-AIU, split by emitting runtime.

azureLogAnalytics.query: let Current = dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), Credits=todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.aiu']) | where op == 'chat' and isnotnull(Credits) | summarize Credits=sum(Credits), timestamp=min(timestamp) by operation_Id, cloud_RoleName | extend priority=2; let Legacy = dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), Credits=todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.nano_aiu']) / 1000000000 | where op == 'invoke_agent' and isnotnull(Credits) | summarize Credits=sum(Credits), timestamp=min(timestamp) by operation_Id, cloud_RoleName | extend priority=1; union Current, Legacy | summarize arg_max(priority, Credits, timestamp) by operation_Id, cloud_RoleName | summarize Credits=sum(Credits) by timestamp=bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Turns by Agent
panels.description: The **second axis**. `cloud_RoleName` says which runtime emitted the span; the agent name/id says what was running inside it. A Copilot CLI session launched from inside VS Code appears under both surfaces — this panel separates them. VS Code sets `gen_ai.agent.name`, the CLI sets `gen_ai.agent.id`, so the query falls back between the two.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), agentName=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']), agentId=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.id']) | where op == 'invoke_agent' | extend agent=iff(isempty(agentName), iff(isempty(agentId), 'unknown', agentId), agentName) | summarize Turns=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), agent | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Cache Tokens: Read vs Created
panels.description: Token *volume* rather than call count — green is what the cache saved you, orange is what had to be rebuilt.

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), cr=tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), cc=tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize CacheReadTokens=sum(cr), CacheCreationTokens=sum(cc) by bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Session Events (truncation / compaction)
panels.description: **Truncation and compaction rewrite the prompt prefix — the direct *cause* of a cache miss.** Line this up with the chart on the left: a spike here should be followed by a jump in cache-creation tokens. The azuremonitor exporter surfaces OTel **span events** in the `traces` table with the event name as `message`. If this panel stays empty while Tempo shows events, run `union traces, customEvents | where cloud_RoleName matches regex 'copilot-chat|github-copilot' | summarize count() by $table, message` to find where your exporter version put them.

azureLogAnalytics.query: traces | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | where message has 'session' | summarize Events=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), message | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: OTLP metrics (needs the collector metrics pipeline)
Copilot OTLP Metrics
panels.description: Copilot emits OTel **metrics** as well as traces — `gen_ai.client.token.usage`, `gen_ai.client.operation.duration`, `gen_ai.client.operation.time_to_first_chunk`, `gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls` / `.tool_calls`, `github.copilot.agent.turn.count`. They only arrive here if your collector has a **metrics pipeline** (`config/otel-collector.yaml` and `config/otel-collector-cloud.yaml` both do; earlier revisions of this repo were traces-only and silently dropped them). Note Tempo can't store metrics, so this panel has no TraceQL equivalent.

azureLogAnalytics.query: customMetrics | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | where name startswith 'gen_ai.' or name startswith 'github.copilot.' | summarize Value=sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 5m), name | order by timestamp asc

dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), model=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize Calls=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), model | order by timestamp asc

dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), model=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize p50_ms=percentile(duration, 50) by bin(timestamp, 5m), model | order by timestamp asc

dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), tool=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name']) | where op == 'execute_tool' | summarize Calls=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), tool | order by timestamp asc

dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | where op == 'chat' | summarize InputTokens=sum(inTok), OutputTokens=sum(outTok) by bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Recent LLM Calls (with surface & cache info)

azureLogAnalytics.query: dependencies | where cloud_RoleName matches regex '$surface' | extend op=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']), model=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model']), cacheRead=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), cacheCreation=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']) | where op == 'chat' | project timestamp, surface=cloud_RoleName, model, cacheRead, cacheCreation, duration_ms=duration | top 50 by timestamp desc

options.content:
## Setup

1. Import this dashboard into Grafana with an **Azure Monitor** data source that can read your Application Insights resource (Monitoring Reader).
2. Set the **Application Insights resource ID** variable, e.g. `/subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/rg-ghcp-otel/providers/microsoft.insights/components/ghcpotel-appi`.
3. Pick a **Copilot surface**.

## GitHub Copilot runtimes (August 2026)

| Runtime | `cloud_RoleName` |
|---------|------------------|
| VS Code Copilot Chat | `copilot-chat` |
| GitHub Copilot CLI / Copilot app | `github-copilot` |
| Claude Code subprocess | `claude-code` |
| JetBrains | *not yet verified* |

Copilot spans land in **`dependencies`**, OTLP metrics in **`customMetrics`**, and enabled span events in **`traces`**. The collector configs set `spaneventsenabled: true`; without it, non-exception truncation/compaction events are dropped by the Azure Monitor exporter.

Current clients use `github.copilot.aiu`; the credit panels fall back to legacy `github.copilot.nano_aiu`. A Copilot CLI session started inside VS Code can emit under both `copilot-chat` and `github-copilot`, so **Turns by Agent** remains the second axis.

## KQL check (Logs)

```kusto
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where cloud_RoleName matches regex 'copilot-chat|github-copilot'
| summarize count() by cloud_RoleName, tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name'])
```

Discover an undocumented runtime: `union dependencies, customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(1d) | summarize count() by cloud_RoleName`.

title: GitHub Copilot OTel — VS Code + CLI (Application Insights / KQL)
